egypt_removed_enrichment.description: Overall enrichment Z-score with Egypt-cluster sites removed (ALL site types combined)

egypt_removed_divergence.description: Monument-settlement DIVERGENCE with Egypt removed (separate Z for each type)
egypt_removed_divergence.note: With Egypt removed, the monument-settlement divergence collapses to near zero. This is expected — Egypt drives the divergence signal.

recommendation.for_merged_paper: Report BOTH metrics clearly: 'With Egypt removed, overall enrichment remains significant (Z=4.51, p<0.001) but monument-settlement divergence collapses (D=-0.64).' The first shows the circle signal exists beyond Egypt; the second shows the divergence is Egypt-driven.
